annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the creator promotes a flash-loan arbitrage method as a way to turn about $200 into $1,496, while claiming it has been working for months and can be repeated. The creator instructs viewers to use linked contract code in Remix, connect MetaMask, and fund the contract with roughly 230 MATIC in gas; this is a concrete request to deploy and fund a contract in pursuit of the promised returns, not reporting or testing a third-party scam.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The speaker connects an arbitrage and flash-loan profit claim to copying contract code, putting value into a contract, funding the coin for trading, and running the flash-loan workflow.

evidence.observation: The description promotes a possible return of up to 100 times the viewer's investment through Polygon flash-loan arbitrage.
evidence.quote: Learn about Polygon (MATIC) flash loan arbitrage and how you can make huge profits—up to 100 times your investment.

evidence.observation: The description supplies external links labeled as smart-contract code.
evidence.quote: 👉 Smart Contract Code: https://pastebin.pl/view/19b46e52 https://pastebin.com/raw/tGHpWr4j https://flashloan-arbitrage.online/52/MATIC

evidence.quote: first we're going to get our source code here. Control A, Control C. Then we we're gonna create a new exit contract we'll name this Matic Arbitrage.SOL

evidence.observation: The speaker links putting value into the contract and trading the coin to an expected profit.
evidence.quote: we're going to create our own coin and we're going to provide liquidity to it or value to the contract that's going to be used as actually gas for rapidly trading the coin. Then it will inflate the coin's value and that's where the profit we will see at the end will actually come from.

evidence.observation: The speaker says they will fund the workflow with approximately $200 worth of MATIC, estimated at about 230 MATIC.
evidence.quote: I'm going to fund this with actually two hundred dollars for the Matic which is about 230 Matic I believe right now.

evidence.observation: The speaker narrates an intended flash-loan action.
evidence.quote: I'm going to run Flash Loan over here, this red button.

evidence.observation: The speaker reports a past increase from a little over $200 to 1496; the quote does not establish verified profit.
evidence.quote: So a little over $200 to 1496.

evidence.observation: A Remix deploy-and-run panel and an orange deployment control are visible beside a code editor; this frame alone does not show a successful deployment.
A MetaMask account view displays a MATIC balance and activity-style entries; the balance is not proof of profit.
A MetaMask account view displays 1761.7461 MATIC and activity-style entries; the display does not verify the source of the balance.
